plan.title: feat(authz): typed escalation events + CLI batch queue (#518 slim)

narratives.Description: Wave 5 optional UX of #2948. Slim #518: versioned typed escalation event schema, local queue store, CLI file/list/resolve/batch-approve for cmd_approval and question types. Full web/Warp UI is residual — first cut is CLI + file queue so grants and finish-loop have a structured escalation channel. Compose with human-origin grants when resolution mints approvals.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator running multi-agent work, I want typed escalations in a batchable CLI queue, so that cmd_approval and questions do not each require a synchronous interrupt.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Escalation schema (types: cmd_approval design_decision approval resource external question) under packages/core/src/escalation/ + content/contracts/escalation.md. Step 2: Store .deft/escalations/<id>.json + list open. Step 3: CLI escalation:file list resolve batch-approve (bulk only for cmd_approval/question; dangerous ops stay individual). Step 4: Swarm skill/preamble pointer for typed escalation. Step 5: Tests + CHANGELOG #518 #2948. Explicit residual: full priority-inbox web UI. drive-to: merge-ready.
narratives.Traces: Wave 5 #518 slim AC of #2948; optional UX

narrative.Acceptance: packages/core exports a versioned escalation schema and persists open escalations under .deft/escalations while unit tests reject invalid types.
escalation:list returns open items and batch-approve resolves only cmd_approval or question types while individual resolve handles design_decision approval and resource.
content/contracts/escalation.md records types and residual full-UI and CHANGELOG Unreleased records #518 under #2948 Wave 5.
